FitnessTracker Private iOS health app

An offline-first iOS fitness tracker with health metrics, goals, charts and a home-screen widget. No data leaves the phone.

In progress: source code only

Try the live demo Read the code

Role
iOS product design and SwiftUI development
Platforms
iOS
Year
2026

The problem

People need a focused way to understand workouts and progress without sending personal health data to a remote service.

What I did

  1. Information

    Structured a daily dashboard around Apple Health metrics, workouts, goals, streaks and progress trends.

  2. Accessibility

    Included English and Arabic RTL considerations, VoiceOver support, reminders and a widget-oriented glanceable view.

  3. Architecture

    Designed a Swift 6 and SwiftUI foundation using SwiftData, HealthKit, Swift Charts, WidgetKit and a simplified Clean Architecture.

Where it stands

The Swift source is public and readable. The Xcode app, test and widget targets still need to be set up on a Mac before the app can be built and released.
